house_style: Quiet traditional stationery for a grade 2 reading tool. Warm pale parchment and deep blue ink. Fine, restrained texture. No text, letters, numbers, logos or people.

assets.name: parchment
assets.prompt: Full-frame pale warm ivory parchment paper texture, evenly lit, very subtle fine paper fibers, faint warm tonal variation, clean unmarked paper with a nearly uniform light center. Texture only, no objects or ornament.

assets.name: flourish
assets.prompt: One small elegant deep blue ink quill with a short curved ink stroke at its base. Simple quiet stationery flourish, centered, isolated on a perfectly flat pure green (#00FF00) background. Entire feather and stroke fully visible with generous space. No ground or cast shadow.
